name: js-ts-toolchain
label: JavaScript / TypeScript toolchain
description: The type checker and the test runner as checks, plus npm and node as commands. Point each one at the binary you use — a node_modules/.bin shim is a normal answer.

tools.label: tsc
tools.description: Type-checks the project without emitting, and reports the TypeScript compiler's diagnostics.

tools.label: vitest
tools.description: Runs the suite once with the JSON reporter and reports each failing test from that document.

tools.label: npm
tools.description: The npm CLI, so a model can read the project's scripts or dependency tree through run_command.

tools.label: node
tools.description: The Node runtime itself, for a one-off script or a --version probe through run_command.
